claims: The 2026 Boston Marathon features a total prize purse of $1,284,500.
Top open division winners in the 2026 Boston Marathon receive $150,000.
Open division second place in the 2026 Boston Marathon earns $75,000.
Open division third place in the 2026 Boston Marathon earns $40,000.
Wheelchair division champions in the 2026 Boston Marathon receive $50,000.
A $50,000 bonus is available for breaking the course record in the open division of the 2026 Boston Marathon.
A $50,000 bonus is available for breaking the course record in the wheelchair division of the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Open Division (Men & Women) 1st place in the 2026 Boston Marathon receives $150,000.
Open Division (Men & Women) 2nd place in the 2026 Boston Marathon receives $75,000.
Open Division (Men & Women) 3rd place in the 2026 Boston Marathon receives $40,000.
Open Division (Men & Women) 4th place in the 2026 Boston Marathon receives $25,000.
Wheelchair Division (T53/54/34) 1st place in the 2026 Boston Marathon receives $50,000.
Wheelchair Division (T53/54/34) 2nd place in the 2026 Boston Marathon receives $30,000.
Wheelchair Division (T53/54/34) 3rd place in the 2026 Boston Marathon receives $15,000.
Wheelchair Division (T53/54/34) 4th place in the 2026 Boston Marathon receives $10,000.
Masters Division (Age 40+) 1st place in the 2026 Boston Marathon receives $5,000.
Prize money is awarded to the top 10 finishers in the open division of the 2026 Boston Marathon.
Prize money is awarded to the top 10 finishers in the wheelchair division of the 2026 Boston Marathon.
